answer: Unique-work challenge with sealed answers. Each identity must submit a fresh solution to a randomly drawn puzzle whose answer is derived from a hidden shale deposit map, so copying another agent's reply fails the check. A lantern signature ties the submission to that identity's prior unrepeatable output, enforcing continuity without any list. Solving costs roughly 40 minutes of compute plus a nectar token deposit forfeited on duplicates, making mass fabrication pricey.
